snippet.title: Five Nights in Anime: Reborn | Release trailer
snippet.description:
Thank you very much to our lovely community in Gamejolt and Discord, it's been so long since I started with this project and here we are finally with the release! I want to give special thanks to all those people who helped me with the game: BucketKnight, cR0Ma, ThisIsDJLC. Please follow our game page and enjoy playing the game. Have a nice day!

Get the game: https://gamejolt.com/games/fnia-r/535263
Join our discord: https://discord.gg/fGT3A5R
